Outage Update: Episode 21: The Alaskan Foreign Legion is going live in a few short minutes.

Come, give us a listen. You might like it

Apologies folks, but this week's show is going to be late due to an issue with our syndication partners over at Pinecast.

We'll try and have it up before East Coast drive time, though.

We're across the line with 15 minutes to spare. This week's broadcast: Episode 20: Put Up Your (Iron) Dukes, goes into syndication in just a few short minutes. 

Buckle up y'all, it's a good ride.
